import math

int number(string text)
    return int(text)

int cents(string text)
    parts := text.split(".")
    return 100 * number(parts[0]) + number(parts[1])

string money(int value)
    return "{value / 100}.{value % 100:02.}"

string rate_text(int value)
    return money(value) + "%"

string duration(int minutes)
    return "{minutes / 60}:{minutes % 60:02.}"

string clock_text(int minutes)
    return "{minutes / 60:02.}:{minutes % 60:02.}"

int clock_value(string text)
    parts := text.split(":")
    hour := number(parts[0])
    minute := number(parts[1])
    return if hour > 23 or minute > 59 then -1 else 60 * hour + minute

int duration_value(string text)
    parts := text.split(":")
    hour := number(parts[0])
    minute := number(parts[1])
    return if minute > 59 then -1 else hour * 60 + minute

string weekday(int day)
    return ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"][(day - 1) % 7]

int period_of(int day)
    return (day - 1) / 14 + 1

string[] field_names()
    return ["R", "O", "D", "N", "P", "accrued", "salary", "leave", "deduction",
            "sales", "commission", "earnings", "bonus", "gross", "retirement",
            "health", "federal", "supplemental", "state", "social", "medicare",
            "garnishment", "net", "employer_social", "employer_medicare",
            "unemployment", "match", "employer", "W", "Y", "F", "J"]

int field_index(string field)
    names := field_names()
    for: 0 <= i < int(#names)
        if names[i] == field
            return i
    return -1

class RatePair(int lower, int rate)
class Shift(int person, int day, int start, int end, bool used)
class Garnishment(int person, int rate, int balance)
class Employee(int id, string department, string kind, int base, bool active, int retirement, int health, int allowances, int extra, int bonus, int pto_balance, int[] ytd, int periods)
class Stub(int[] amounts, int[] balances, int post_pto, int post_garnishment)
class State()
    closed := 0
    setting_names := ["STATE", "SUPP", "SSRATE", "MEDRATE", "ADDMED",
                              "UIRATE", "MATCH", "MATCHMAX", "GARNCAP",
                              "SSBASE", "ADDBASE", "UIBASE", "RETIRECAP",
                              "ALLOWANCE", "NIGHT"]
    settings := [500, 2200, 620, 145, 90, 270, 5000, 600, 2500,
                      16860000, 20000000, 700000, 2300000, 15000, 100]
    RatePair[] brackets := []
    RatePair[] tiers := []
    holidays := array(365, fill = false)
    employees := array(50, fill = Employee(0, "", "", 0, false,
                                    0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, array(32, fill = 0), 0))
    employee_used := 0
    shifts := array(1000, fill = Shift(0, 0, 0, 0, false))
    shift_used := 0
    garnishments := array(500, fill = Garnishment(0, 0, 0))
    garnishment_used := 0
    int[][] pto := array(50, fill = array(365, fill = 0))
    bool[][] has_pto := array(50, fill = array(365, fill = false))
    bool[][] leave := array(50, fill = array(365, fill = false))
    int[][] sales := array(50, fill = array(27, fill = 0))
    Stub[][] stubs := array(50, fill = array(27, fill = Stub(array(32, fill = 0), [], 0, 0)))
    bool[][] has_stub := array(50, fill = array(27, fill = false))
    string[][] stub_departments := array(50, fill = array(27, fill = ""))

Stub empty_stub()
    return Stub(array(32, fill = 0), [], 0, 0)

int get(const Stub stub, string field)
    return stub.amounts[field_index(field)]

void put(Stub &stub, string field, int value)
    stub.amounts[field_index(field)] = value

void emit(string text)
    println(text)

void fail(string reason)
    emit("ERROR " + reason)

int setting_id(const State state, string name)
    for: 0 <= i < 15
        if state.setting_names[i] == name
            return i
    return -1

int setting(const State state, string name)
    return state.settings[setting_id(state, name)]

int employee_id(const State state, int id)
    for: 0 <= i < state.employee_used
        if state.employees[i].id == id
            return i
    return -1

int[] employee_order(const State state)
    order := [for i := (0:<int(state.employee_used))[] then i]
    for: 1 <= k < int(#order)
        item := order[k]
        position := k
        while position > 0 and state.employees[order[position - 1]].id > state.employees[item].id
            order[position] = order[position - 1]
            position -= 1
        order[position] = item
    return order

int[] garnishment_ids(const State state, int person)
    return [for i := (0:<int(state.garnishment_used))[]
            if state.garnishments[i].person == person then i]

int garnishment_balance(const State state, int person)
    amount := 0
    for i := garnishment_ids(state, person)[]
        amount += state.garnishments[i].balance
    return amount

int progressive(const RatePair[] table, int amount)
    numerator := 0
    for entry := table[]
        if entry.lower >= amount
            continue
        upper := amount
        for next := table[]
            if next.lower > entry.lower
                upper = math.min(upper, next.lower)
        numerator += entry.rate * (upper - entry.lower)
    return numerator / 10000

int[] daily(const State state, int person, int day)
    worked := 0
    night := 0
    for: 0 <= i < state.shift_used
        shift := state.shifts[i]
        if not shift.used or shift.person != person or shift.day != day
            continue
        worked += shift.end - shift.start
        night += math.max(0, math.min(shift.end, 360) - shift.start)
        night += math.max(0, shift.end - math.max(shift.start, 1320))
    pto := state.pto[person][day]
    if day % 7 == 0 or state.holidays[day]
        return [worked, 0, 0, worked, night, pto]
    return [worked, math.min(worked, 480),
            math.min(math.max(0, worked - 480), 240),
            math.max(0, worked - 720), night, pto]

int[] weekly(const State state, int person, int week)
    totals := array(6, fill = 0)
    for: 7 * week - 6 <= day <= 7 * week
        values := daily(state, person, day)
        for: 0 <= k < 5
            totals[k] += values[k + 1]
    extra := math.max(0, totals[0] - 2400)
    totals[0] -= extra
    totals[1] += extra
    totals[5] = extra
    return totals

int[] breakdown(const State state, int person, int period)
    first := weekly(state, person, 2 * period - 1)
    second := weekly(state, person, 2 * period)
    return [for i := (0:<5)[] then first[i] + second[i]]

int deduct(Stub &stub, string field, int proposal, int available)
    amount := math.min(proposal, available)
    put(&stub, field, amount)
    return available - amount

Stub calculate(const State state, int person, int period)
    employee := state.employees[person]
    stub := empty_stub()
    if employee.kind == "HOURLY"
        values := breakdown(state, person, period)
        for: 0 <= i < 5
            stub.amounts[i] = values[i]
        weighted := 2 * (values[0] + values[4]) + 3 * values[1] + 4 * values[2]
        put(&stub, "earnings", (weighted * employee.base + 2 * values[3] * setting(state, "NIGHT")) / 120)
    elif employee.kind == "SALARIED"
        if employee.active
            days := 0
            for: 14 * period - 13 <= day <= 14 * period
                if state.leave[person][day] and not state.holidays[day]
                    days += 1
            salary := employee.base / 26
            deduction := days * (employee.base / 260)
            put(&stub, "salary", salary)
            put(&stub, "leave", days)
            put(&stub, "deduction", deduction)
            put(&stub, "earnings", salary - deduction)
    else
        sales := state.sales[person][period]
        commission := progressive(state.tiers, sales)
        put(&stub, "sales", sales)
        put(&stub, "commission", commission)
        put(&stub, "earnings", commission + (if employee.active then employee.base else 0))
    put(&stub, "bonus", employee.bonus)
    gross := get(stub, "earnings") + employee.bonus
    if gross == 0
        return stub
    put(&stub, "gross", gross)
    available := gross
    room := math.max(0, setting(state, "RETIRECAP") - employee.ytd[field_index("retirement")])
    available = deduct(&stub, "retirement", math.min(gross * employee.retirement / 10000, room), available)
    available = deduct(&stub, "health", employee.health, available)
    put(&stub, "W", available)
    taxable := math.max(0, get(stub, "earnings") - get(stub, "retirement") - get(stub, "health"))
    allowances := math.max(0, taxable - employee.allowances * setting(state, "ALLOWANCE"))
    available = deduct(&stub, "federal", progressive(state.brackets, allowances) + employee.extra, available)
    available = deduct(&stub, "supplemental", (get(stub, "W") - taxable) * setting(state, "SUPP") / 10000, available)
    available = deduct(&stub, "state", get(stub, "W") * setting(state, "STATE") / 10000, available)
    medicare_wages := gross - get(stub, "health")
    social_wages := math.min(medicare_wages, math.max(0, setting(state, "SSBASE") - employee.ytd[field_index("Y")]))
    additional := math.max(0, math.min(medicare_wages, employee.ytd[field_index("F")] + medicare_wages - setting(state, "ADDBASE")))
    put(&stub, "F", medicare_wages)
    put(&stub, "Y", social_wages)
    available = deduct(&stub, "social", social_wages * setting(state, "SSRATE") / 10000, available)
    available = deduct(&stub, "medicare", medicare_wages * setting(state, "MEDRATE") / 10000 + additional * setting(state, "ADDMED") / 10000, available)
    disposable := available
    cap := disposable * setting(state, "GARNCAP") / 10000
    garnished := 0
    int[] balances := []
    for order := garnishment_ids(state, person)[]
        entry := state.garnishments[order]
        taken := math.min(disposable * entry.rate / 10000, math.min(entry.balance, cap - garnished))
        garnished += taken
        balances = balances.append(entry.balance - taken)
    stub.balances = balances
    stub.post_garnishment = balances.sum()
    put(&stub, "garnishment", garnished)
    put(&stub, "net", available - garnished)
    put(&stub, "employer_social", social_wages * setting(state, "SSRATE") / 10000)
    put(&stub, "employer_medicare", medicare_wages * setting(state, "MEDRATE") / 10000)
    unemployment_wages := math.min(medicare_wages, math.max(0, setting(state, "UIBASE") - employee.ytd[field_index("J")]))
    put(&stub, "J", unemployment_wages)
    put(&stub, "unemployment", unemployment_wages * setting(state, "UIRATE") / 10000)
    eligible := math.min(get(stub, "retirement"), gross * setting(state, "MATCHMAX") / 10000)
    put(&stub, "match", eligible * setting(state, "MATCH") / 10000)
    put(&stub, "employer", get(stub, "employer_social") + get(stub, "employer_medicare") + get(stub, "unemployment") + get(stub, "match"))
    if employee.kind == "HOURLY"
        accrued := math.min(960 - employee.pto_balance, (get(stub, "R") + get(stub, "O") + get(stub, "D")) / 20)
        put(&stub, "accrued", accrued)
    stub.post_pto = employee.pto_balance + get(stub, "accrued")
    return stub

string hours_parts(int[] minutes)
    labels := ["reg", "ot", "dbl", "night", "pto"]
    return [for i := (0:<5)[] then labels[i] + " " + duration(minutes[i])].join(" ")

void stub_block(string kind, const Stub stub, string indent)
    if kind == "HOURLY"
        minutes := [get(stub, "R"), get(stub, "O"), get(stub, "D"), get(stub, "N"), get(stub, "P")]
        emit(indent + "hours " + hours_parts(minutes))
        emit(indent + "pto accrued " + duration(get(stub, "accrued")) + " balance " + duration(stub.post_pto))
    elif kind == "SALARIED"
        emit(indent + "salary " + money(get(stub, "salary")) + " leave " + string(get(stub, "leave")) + " deduction " + money(get(stub, "deduction")))
    else
        emit(indent + "sales " + money(get(stub, "sales")) + " commission " + money(get(stub, "commission")))
    fields := ["earnings", "bonus", "gross", "retirement", "health", "federal",
                       "supplemental", "state", "social", "medicare"]
    for name := fields[]
        emit(indent + (if name == "social" then "social-security" else name) + " " + money(get(stub, name)))
    emit(indent + "garnishment " + money(get(stub, "garnishment")) + " balance " + money(stub.post_garnishment))
    emit(indent + "net " + money(get(stub, "net")))
    emit(indent + "employer social-security " + money(get(stub, "employer_social")) + " medicare " + money(get(stub, "employer_medicare")) + " unemployment " + money(get(stub, "unemployment")) + " match " + money(get(stub, "match")))

void print_stub(const Employee employee, int period, const Stub stub, string department)
    emit("  STUB " + string(employee.id) + " " + department + " " + employee.kind + " period " + string(period))
    stub_block(employee.kind, stub, "    ")

int[] sum_stubs(const Stub[] stubs)
    totals := array(32, fill = 0)
    for stub := stubs[]
        for: 0 <= k < 32
            totals[k] += stub.amounts[k]
    return totals

Stub with_values(int[] values, pto_balance := 0, remaining_garnishment := 0)
    return Stub(values, [], pto_balance, remaining_garnishment)

void show_hours(const State state, int person, int period)
    employee := state.employees[person]
    emit("HOURS " + string(employee.id) + " period " + string(period))
    found := false
    for: 14 * period - 13 <= day <= 14 * period
        int[] starts := []
        int[] ends := []
        for: 0 <= k < state.shift_used
            shift := state.shifts[k]
            if shift.used and shift.person == person and shift.day == day
                location := int(#starts)
                starts = starts.append(shift.start)
                ends = ends.append(shift.end)
                while location > 0 and starts[location - 1] > starts[location]
                    temp := starts[location]
                    starts[location] = starts[location - 1]
                    starts[location - 1] = temp
                    temp = ends[location]
                    ends[location] = ends[location - 1]
                    ends[location - 1] = temp
                    location -= 1
        if #starts == 0 and not state.has_pto[person][day]
            continue
        found = true
        values := daily(state, person, day)
        line := "  day " + string(day) + " " + weekday(day) + (if state.holidays[day] then " holiday" else "")
        for: 0 <= k < int(#starts)
            line += " " + clock_text(starts[k]) + "-" + clock_text(ends[k])
        line += " total " + duration(values[0]) + " " + hours_parts(values[1:<6])
        emit(line)
    if not found
        emit("  (none)")
    for: 2 * period - 1 <= week <= 2 * period
        values := weekly(state, person, week)
        emit("  week " + string(week) + " " + hours_parts(values[:<5]) + " weekly-ot " + duration(values[5]))
    emit("  total " + hours_parts(breakdown(state, person, period)))

void run(State &state, int period)
    state.closed = period
    emit("RUN " + string(period) + " days " + string(14 * period - 13) + "-" + string(14 * period))
    paid := 0
    skipped := 0
    Stub[] stubs := []
    for person := employee_order(state)[]
        stub := calculate(state, person, period)
        if get(stub, "gross") == 0
            if state.employees[person].active
                skipped += 1
            continue
        employee := state.employees[person]
        print_stub(employee, period, stub, employee.department)
        state.employees[person].bonus = 0
        state.employees[person].pto_balance = stub.post_pto
        orders := garnishment_ids(state, person)
        for: 0 <= k < int(#orders)
            state.garnishments[orders[k]].balance = stub.balances[k]
        for: 0 <= k < 32
            state.employees[person].ytd[k] += stub.amounts[k]
        state.employees[person].periods += 1
        state.stubs[person][period] = stub
        state.has_stub[person][period] = true
        state.stub_departments[person][period] = employee.department
        stubs = stubs.append(stub)
        paid += 1
    totals := sum_stubs(stubs)
    gross := totals[field_index("gross")]
    net := totals[field_index("net")]
    emit("  TOTAL paid " + string(paid) + " skipped " + string(skipped) + " gross " + money(gross) + " deductions " + money(gross - net) + " net " + money(net) + " employer " + money(totals[field_index("employer")]))

void journal(const State state, int period)
    Stub[] stubs := []
    for: 0 <= person < state.employee_used
        if state.has_stub[person][period]
            stubs = stubs.append(state.stubs[person][period])
    total := with_values(sum_stubs(stubs))
    debit_tax := get(total, "employer_social") + get(total, "employer_medicare") + get(total, "unemployment")
    debit_match := get(total, "match")
    credit_fica := get(total, "social") + get(total, "medicare") + get(total, "employer_social") + get(total, "employer_medicare")
    emit("JOURNAL " + string(period) + " stubs " + string(#stubs))
    emit("  debit wages " + money(get(total, "gross")))
    emit("  debit employer-tax " + money(debit_tax))
    emit("  debit retirement-match " + money(debit_match))
    emit("  credit retirement " + money(get(total, "retirement") + debit_match))
    emit("  credit health " + money(get(total, "health")))
    emit("  credit federal " + money(get(total, "federal") + get(total, "supplemental")))
    emit("  credit state " + money(get(total, "state")))
    emit("  credit fica " + money(credit_fica))
    emit("  credit unemployment " + money(get(total, "unemployment")))
    emit("  credit garnishment " + money(get(total, "garnishment")))
    emit("  credit net-pay " + money(get(total, "net")))
    debit := get(total, "gross") + debit_tax + debit_match
    credit := get(total, "retirement") + debit_match + get(total, "health") + get(total, "federal") + get(total, "supplemental") + get(total, "state") + credit_fica + get(total, "unemployment") + get(total, "garnishment") + get(total, "net")
    emit("  total debit " + money(debit) + " credit " + money(credit))

void report_line(string department, const Stub[] stubs)
    total := with_values(sum_stubs(stubs))
    taxes := get(total, "federal") + get(total, "supplemental") + get(total, "state") + get(total, "social") + get(total, "medicare")
    emit("  " + department + " stubs " + string(#stubs) + " gross " + money(get(total, "gross")) + " pretax " + money(get(total, "retirement") + get(total, "health")) + " taxes " + money(taxes) + " garnishment " + money(get(total, "garnishment")) + " net " + money(get(total, "net")) + " employer " + money(get(total, "employer")))

void report(const State state)
    emit("REPORT period " + string(state.closed))
    string[] departments := []
    Stub[] all_stubs := []
    for: 0 <= person < state.employee_used
        for: 1 <= period <= state.closed
            if state.has_stub[person][period]
                department := state.stub_departments[person][period]
                listed := false
                for previous := departments[]
                    if previous == department
                        listed = true
                if not listed
                    departments = departments.append(department)
                all_stubs = all_stubs.append(state.stubs[person][period])
    departments = departments.sorted()
    for department := departments[]
        Stub[] selected := []
        for: 0 <= person < state.employee_used
            for: 1 <= period <= state.closed
                if state.has_stub[person][period] and state.stub_departments[person][period] == department
                    selected = selected.append(state.stubs[person][period])
        report_line(department, selected)
    report_line("total", all_stubs)

void top(const State state, int count)
    order := [for i := (0:<int(state.employee_used))[]
                   if state.employees[i].periods > 0 then i]
    for: 1 <= k < int(#order)
        item := order[k]
        position := k
        while position > 0 and (state.employees[order[position - 1]].ytd[field_index("gross")] < state.employees[item].ytd[field_index("gross")] or (state.employees[order[position - 1]].ytd[field_index("gross")] == state.employees[item].ytd[field_index("gross")] and state.employees[order[position - 1]].id > state.employees[item].id))
            order[position] = order[position - 1]
            position -= 1
        order[position] = item
    emit("TOP " + string(count))
    if #order == 0
        emit("  (none)")
    for: 0 <= rank < math.min(count, int(#order))
        employee := state.employees[order[rank]]
        emit("  " + string(rank + 1) + " " + string(employee.id) + " " + employee.department + " gross " + money(employee.ytd[field_index("gross")]) + " net " + money(employee.ytd[field_index("net")]))

void employees_report(const State state)
    emit("EMPLOYEES")
    if state.employee_used == 0
        emit("  (none)")
    for person := employee_order(state)[]
        employee := state.employees[person]
        emit("  " + string(employee.id) + " " + employee.department + " " + employee.kind + " " + money(employee.base) + " " + (if employee.active then "active" else "terminated") + " retirement " + rate_text(employee.retirement) + " health " + money(employee.health) + " allowances " + string(employee.allowances) + " extra " + money(employee.extra) + " bonus " + money(employee.bonus))
        orders := garnishment_ids(state, person)
        for: 0 <= k < int(#orders)
            order := state.garnishments[orders[k]]
            emit("    garnish " + string(k + 1) + " " + rate_text(order.rate) + " balance " + money(order.balance))

void config(const State state)
    emit("CONFIG")
    for: 0 <= k < 15
        int value := state.settings[k]
        emit("  " + state.setting_names[k] + " " + (if k < 9 then rate_text(value) else money(value)))
    lowers := [for item := state.brackets[] then item.lower]
    lowers = lowers.sorted()
    for lower := lowers[]
        for item := state.brackets[]
            if item.lower == lower
                emit("  bracket " + money(lower) + " " + rate_text(item.rate))
    lowers = [for item := state.tiers[] then item.lower]
    lowers = lowers.sorted()
    for lower := lowers[]
        for item := state.tiers[]
            if item.lower == lower
                emit("  tier " + money(lower) + " " + rate_text(item.rate))

void command(State &state, string line)
    words := line.split(" ")
    action := words[0]
    if action == "SET"
        id := setting_id(state, words[1])
        if id < 0
            fail("unknown setting " + words[1])
            return
        value := cents(words[2])
        if id < 9 and value > 10000
            fail("invalid rate " + words[2])
            return
        int prior := state.settings[id]
        state.settings[id] = value
        emit("SET " + words[1] + " " + (if id < 9 then rate_text(prior) else money(prior)) + " -> " + (if id < 9 then rate_text(value) else money(value)))
        return
    if action == "BRACKET" or action == "TIER"
        lower := cents(words[1])
        rate := cents(words[2])
        if rate > 10000
            fail("invalid rate " + words[2])
            return
        table := if action == "BRACKET" then state.brackets else state.tiers
        replaced := false
        for: 0 <= k < int(#table)
            if table[k].lower == lower
                table[k].rate = rate
                replaced = true
        if not replaced
            table = table.append(RatePair(lower, rate))
        if action == "BRACKET"
            state.brackets = table
        else
            state.tiers = table
        emit(action + " " + money(lower) + " " + rate_text(rate) + (if replaced then " replaced" else " added"))
        return
    if action == "EMP"
        id := number(words[1])
        if employee_id(state, id) >= 0
            fail("duplicate employee " + words[1])
            return
        base := cents(words[4])
        if base == 0
            fail("invalid amount")
            return
        person := state.employee_used
        state.employee_used += 1
        state.employees[person] = Employee(id, words[2], words[3], base, true, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, array(32, fill = 0), 0)
        emit("EMP " + string(id) + " " + words[2] + " " + words[3] + " " + money(base))
        return
    if action == "HOLIDAY"
        day := number(words[1])
        if day < 1 or day > 364
            fail("invalid day " + words[1])
        elif period_of(day) <= state.closed
            fail("period closed " + string(period_of(day)))
        elif state.holidays[day]
            fail("duplicate holiday " + words[1])
        else
            state.holidays[day] = true
            emit("HOLIDAY " + string(day) + " " + weekday(day))
        return
    if action == "RUN"
        period := number(words[1])
        if period != state.closed + 1 or period > 26
            fail("invalid period " + words[1])
        else
            run(&state, period)
        return
    if action == "JOURNAL"
        period := number(words[1])
        if period < 1 or period > state.closed
            fail("no run " + words[1])
        else
            journal(state, period)
        return
    if action == "REPORT"
        report(state)
        return
    if action == "TOP"
        top(state, number(words[1]))
        return
    if action == "EMPLOYEES"
        employees_report(state)
        return
    if action == "CONFIG"
        config(state)
        return

    person := employee_id(state, number(words[1]))
    if person < 0
        fail("unknown employee " + words[1])
        return
    employee := state.employees[person]
    if action == "PREVIEW"
        period := state.closed + 1
        stub := calculate(state, person, period)
        emit("PREVIEW " + string(employee.id) + " period " + string(period))
        if get(stub, "gross") == 0
            emit("  no pay")
        else
            print_stub(employee, period, stub, employee.department)
        return
    if action == "REPRINT"
        period := number(words[2])
        if period < 1 or period > 26
            fail("invalid period " + words[2])
        elif not state.has_stub[person][period]
            fail("no stub " + words[1] + " " + words[2])
        else
            emit("REPRINT " + string(employee.id) + " " + string(period))
            print_stub(employee, period, state.stubs[person][period], state.stub_departments[person][period])
        return
    if action == "YTD"
        emit("YTD " + string(employee.id) + " " + employee.department + " " + employee.kind + " " + (if employee.active then "active" else "terminated") + " periods " + string(employee.periods))
        totals := with_values(employee.ytd, employee.pto_balance, garnishment_balance(state, person))
        stub_block(employee.kind, totals, "  ")
        emit("  wages federal " + money(get(totals, "W")) + " social-security " + money(get(totals, "Y")) + " medicare " + money(get(totals, "F")) + " unemployment " + money(get(totals, "J")))
        emit("  retirement-room " + money(math.max(0, setting(state, "RETIRECAP") - get(totals, "retirement"))) + " pending-bonus " + money(employee.bonus))
        return
    if action == "HOURS"
        if employee.kind != "HOURLY"
            fail("not hourly " + words[1])
            return
        period := number(words[2])
        if period < 1 or period > 26
            fail("invalid period " + words[2])
        else
            show_hours(state, person, period)
        return
    if not employee.active
        fail("terminated employee " + words[1])
        return
    if action == "RATE"
        value := cents(words[2])
        if value == 0
            fail("invalid amount")
            return
        state.employees[person].base = value
        emit("RATE " + words[1] + " " + money(employee.base) + " -> " + money(value))
        return
    if action == "DEPT"
        if words[2] == employee.department
            fail("same department " + words[2])
        else
            state.employees[person].department = words[2]
            emit("DEPT " + words[1] + " " + employee.department + " -> " + words[2])
        return
    if action == "BENEFIT"
        rate := cents(words[2])
        if rate > 10000
            fail("invalid rate " + words[2])
        else
            state.employees[person].retirement = rate
            state.employees[person].health = cents(words[3])
            emit("BENEFIT " + words[1] + " retirement " + rate_text(rate) + " health " + money(cents(words[3])))
        return
    if action == "W4"
        state.employees[person].allowances = number(words[2])
        state.employees[person].extra = cents(words[3])
        emit("W4 " + words[1] + " allowances " + words[2] + " extra " + money(cents(words[3])))
        return
    if action == "GARNISH"
        rate := cents(words[2])
        if rate > 10000
            fail("invalid rate " + words[2])
            return
        amount := cents(words[3])
        if amount == 0
            fail("invalid amount")
            return
        count := int(#garnishment_ids(state, person)) + 1
        state.garnishments[state.garnishment_used] = Garnishment(person, rate, amount)
        state.garnishment_used += 1
        emit("GARNISH " + words[1] + " order " + string(count) + " " + rate_text(rate) + " balance " + money(amount))
        return
    if action == "TERM"
        state.employees[person].active = false
        emit("TERM " + words[1])
        return
    if action == "BONUS"
        amount := cents(words[2])
        if amount == 0
            fail("invalid amount")
        else
            state.employees[person].bonus += amount
            emit("BONUS " + words[1] + " " + money(amount) + " pending " + money(state.employees[person].bonus))
        return

    required := if action == "LEAVE" then "SALARIED" elif action == "SALES" then "COMMISSION" else "HOURLY"
    if employee.kind != required
        fail("not " + (if required == "SALARIED" then "salaried" elif required == "COMMISSION" then "commission" else "hourly") + " " + words[1])
        return
    day := number(words[2])
    if day < 1 or day > 364
        fail("invalid day " + words[2])
        return
    if period_of(day) <= state.closed
        fail("period closed " + string(period_of(day)))
        return

    if action == "TIME"
        start := clock_value(words[3])
        if start < 0
            fail("invalid time " + words[3])
            return
        end := clock_value(words[4])
        if end < 0
            fail("invalid time " + words[4])
            return
        if start >= end
            fail("invalid shift " + words[3] + "-" + words[4])
            return
        worked := end - start
        earliest := -1
        for: 0 <= i < state.shift_used
            shift := state.shifts[i]
            if shift.used and shift.person == person and shift.day == day
                worked += shift.end - shift.start
                if start < shift.end and shift.start < end
                    if earliest < 0 or shift.start < state.shifts[earliest].start
                        earliest = i
        if earliest >= 0
            overlap := state.shifts[earliest]
            fail("overlapping shift " + clock_text(overlap.start) + "-" + clock_text(overlap.end))
            return
        if worked > 960
            fail("daily limit " + words[1] + " " + words[2])
            return
        state.shifts[state.shift_used] = Shift(person, day, start, end, true)
        state.shift_used += 1
        emit("TIME " + words[1] + " day " + string(day) + " " + clock_text(start) + "-" + clock_text(end) + " " + duration(end - start))
        return
    if action == "UNTIME"
        start := clock_value(words[3])
        if start < 0
            fail("invalid time " + words[3])
            return
        for: 0 <= i < state.shift_used
            shift := state.shifts[i]
            if shift.used and shift.person == person and shift.day == day and shift.start == start
                state.shifts[i].used = false
                emit("UNTIME " + words[1] + " day " + string(day) + " " + clock_text(shift.start) + "-" + clock_text(shift.end))
                return
        fail("no shift " + words[1] + " " + words[2] + " " + words[3])
        return
    if action == "PTO"
        minutes := duration_value(words[3])
        if minutes < 1 or minutes > 480
            fail("invalid duration " + words[3])
        elif state.has_pto[person][day]
            fail("duplicate pto " + words[1] + " " + words[2])
        elif minutes > employee.pto_balance
            fail("insufficient pto " + words[1] + " " + duration(employee.pto_balance))
        else
            state.pto[person][day] = minutes
            state.has_pto[person][day] = true
            state.employees[person].pto_balance -= minutes
            emit("PTO " + words[1] + " day " + string(day) + " " + duration(minutes) + " balance " + duration(state.employees[person].pto_balance))
        return
    if action == "LEAVE"
        if day % 7 == 0 or day % 7 == 6 or state.holidays[day]
            fail("not workday " + words[2])
        elif state.leave[person][day]
            fail("duplicate leave " + words[1] + " " + words[2])
        else
            state.leave[person][day] = true
            emit("LEAVE " + words[1] + " day " + string(day) + " " + weekday(day))
        return
    if action == "SALES"
        amount := cents(words[3])
        if amount == 0
            fail("invalid amount")
        else
            period := period_of(day)
            state.sales[person][period] += amount
            emit("SALES " + words[1] + " day " + string(day) + " " + money(amount) + " period " + string(period) + " total " + money(state.sales[person][period]))
